---

I've simplified the UI by making the following changes:

1. Combined all the information into a single card instead of having separate cards for progress, food addition, and daily summary
2. Removed the "Add Food" button and made the counter directly control the amount fed
3. Simplified the daily summary to only show the remaining amount needed
4. Made the counter update the food amount in real-time
5. Improved the visual hierarchy with better typography and spacing

The new UI now:
- Shows the progress indicator at the top
- Displays the current amount fed and target amount in a clear format
- Has a counter that directly controls the amount fed (you can add or subtract 1/4 cup at a time)
- Shows the remaining amount needed to reach the daily target
- Keeps the reset button at the bottom

The interface is now more streamlined and intuitive, with all the information visible at a glance and real-time updates as you adjust the amount. Let me know if you'd like any adjustments to this new layout!
